about: ACS 2020-2024 5-year, same shape as geos[key] in src/core2/data/opening-partnership.json (population by sex over populationBands; marital/neverMarried/spousePresent by sex over maritalBands; arrangements over arrangementBands; households). Key = 7-digit place GEOID (state FIPS + place FIPS), Puerto Rico places included. 'n' is the Census place name. Shrinkage guidance: use w = tau2/(tau2 + 2*p*(1-p)/n) of the place's own share toward its state row, with n the place's count in that cell and tau about 0.10 for never-married shares of women 25-34 (between-place SD in places with 2,000+ such women).
